hero.title: The Creator Advertising Platform
paragraphs: Tano enables consumer brands to partner with creators programmatically, running it like a performance channel. Everything from creator sourcing to outreach, payment and reporting is handled for you.

sections.heading: The worlds most ambitious consumer brands build their creator programmes with Tano
Creator programmes that scale at the speed of AI.

blocks.html: Tano runs your creator programme as an iterative loop that continuously improves and scales to your needs. Run thousands of creator partnerships with the care you’d give ten.

items.title: Your setup
items.body: You choose what the programme is for, which products to gift and the guardrails every creator works within, such as no competitor partnerships and a clear #ad on every post. Everything Tano does next works from this setup, so the programme starts out pointing the way you want.

items.title: Find your creators
items.body: Tano scores thousands of creators on how likely they are to post and sell for you, working from your objective and within your guardrails. Those whose audiences buy through links and who clear every guardrail are shortlisted, so the creators you gift to are the ones most likely to sell.

items.title: Get them posting
items.body: Tano’s agents write to each shortlisted creator personally, drawing on their own posts, then match a gift from your product range and book the delivery. Every message stays within your guardrails, so creators reply to a conversation rather than a template.

items.title: Learn what works
items.body: Tano tests who to recruit, what to say and which incentive to offer, each measured against your objective and your products. The winners scale on their own while the tests keep running, so the programme keeps learning which creators, messages and rewards sell best.

sections.heading: Every conversation shapes the next one.

blocks.html: Tano’s agents talk to every creator one to one, over email, giving each of them a personalised, high-touch experience they don’t receive elsewhere. Before each reply they read the brand’s rules and the creator’s whole history, so every conversation teaches Tano what that creator cares about, what works and what doesn’t.

sections.heading: Every result changes who we pick next.

blocks.html: Tano tests creators, messages, incentives and content side by side, then compares what each combination converts. The best sellers join your proven pool, and every round starts from what worked, so your programme gets cheaper to run.

items.title: What does Tano do?
items.body: Tano runs performance-driven creator programmes at scale, from sourcing and vetting to outreach, product gifting, ongoing relationships and performance tracking. We also help you identify creator content to use in paid ads.

items.title: Is Tano a self-serve platform?
items.body: No. Tano manages the programme for you through its own platform. Your team sets the direction, provides brand feedback and selects content for paid media.

items.title: What does Tano cost?
items.body: Tano is paid on results. It earns when a creator's post goes live, and most of all through a 20% share of the sales those creators drive. Tano carries the upfront risk alongside you: it finds, onboards and sends product to every creator, and if a creator doesn't post, Tano doesn't get paid. The fee per post falls as your programme grows. Programmes start at 100 seeded products a month, which typically comes to about $3,000. Product, shipping, creator commissions, milestone rewards, content rights and media spend should also be included in your budget.

items.title: Can Tano work alongside our agency or existing tools?
items.body: Yes. Tano can manage the smaller-creator programme while your team or agency retains responsibility for larger partnerships, PR and media buying.

items.title: Does Tano replace TikTok Shop?
items.body: Not necessarily. The programmes can run separately, with creator lists cross-referenced to manage overlap.

items.title: Do we need Shopify?
items.body: Tano supports automated gifting through Shopify. If you use another ordering system, compatibility and the fulfilment approach need to be confirmed before launch.
